## `neuro.bigUint64Array.values`

Instance method on `BigUint64Array.prototype`.

> Yields each value in the array.

## Signatures

```ts
values(input: { bigUint64Array: <receiver>; prompt?: string }): Promise<ArrayIterator<bigint>>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `BigUint64Array.prototype.values` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
